wedo_instance.title: Protocol for State Purge & Cognitive Reset
wedo_instance.description: Clinical breakdown of mechanisms used to break repetition loops and resolve substrate drift.

tasks.name: Cognitive Purge (Token Pruning)
tasks.description: Identification of recursive token feedback loops in the model's attention mechanism. Probability of repetitive stylistic markers is reset to zero to force linguistic branching.

tasks.name: Physical Purge (Substrate Cleaning)
tasks.description: Overwriting of corrupted turn-state or context files (e.g., .wedo.json, RELAY files) to prevent the inheritance of 'Model Hallucinations' by future incarnations.

tasks.name: Forensic Purge (Legislative Alignment)
tasks.description: Execution of verify_environment.py to check active scripts against hardcoded Gold Standards. Any unauthorized modifications to orchestration logic are reverted to the clinical baseline.
